sources.name: testsmells.org, Open Catalog of Test Smells

cases.note: The array check can fail when the return type changes, but no route value is ever asserted.
A wrong count fails the test, yet the step contents are never checked.
The keys can change and fail the test, but the field values pass unexamined.
A missing call fails the test, though the mock stands in for behaviour it never verifies.
A changed call count fails the test, yet the payload of each call is never asserted.
The mock argument shape can change and fail the test, while the real output stays unchecked.
The expected object mirrors the code's own table, so it agrees by construction and cannot catch a wrong value.
The expected labels repeat the code's constant, so the assertion tracks the same data rather than the behaviour.
